headline: Google DeepMind is opening a robotics lab in Cambridge, near Boston, led by a former Boston Dynamics technology chief who is recruiting machinists and engineers.

importance_line: Robotics engineers and machinists in the Boston area are the people most directly affected, but the news rests on one recruitment post with no budget, size or opening date.
summary: AI Insider reports, citing a LinkedIn recruitment post of 12 Oct 2026 by Aaron Saunders, Google DeepMind's vice president of embodied systems and robotics and a former chief technology officer of Boston Dynamics, that DeepMind is building a robotics lab in Cambridge, Massachusetts, for a hardware team that has been under development since he joined almost a year ago. Saunders, who joined DeepMind in November 2025 after more than two decades at Boston Dynamics, is hiring machinists, engineers and researchers to bring artificial general intelligence into the physical world.
